Chapter 457: Chapter 6 Is This the Prodigy You Were Talking About? (Please Subscribe)

“Gourd.”

Lin Yuan looked at the grey-yellow gourd resting on his palm.

The moment it touched Lin Yuan’s palm, the originally grey-yellow colored gourd immediately lost its yellow hue and turned into an ordinary-looking grey gourd.

“It can even sense whether I have absorbed the liquid inside…”

Lin Yuan was slightly surprised.

Based on his experience using the gourd, its surface color depended on the user’s degree of absorption of the liquid within.

...

For instance, in the Main World, Lin Yuan absorbed an orange-yellow liquid, hence the surface of the gourd also transformed from grey to grey-yellow.

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned solemn.

The liquid inside the grey gourd greatly enhanced his combat power.

Especially with regard to the expanse of his Inner World, which currently spanned four million square miles, just returning to the enhancement levels from the Main World,

would skyrocket his Inner World to twenty million square miles.

And that was just the enhancement from the orange-yellow liquid, not to mention the other five types of liquids.

Lin Yuan could hardly imagine, once all seven types of liquids were thoroughly absorbed, to what extent would his Inner World grow?

“First, a blood drop to confirm eligibility.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and let a drop of his blood fall on the surface of the gourd.

Only beings whose bloodlines contained the ‘Power of Rebirth’ could activate the gourd.

For Lin Yuan, the so-called ‘Power of Rebirth’ was the essence of the Divine Skill ‘Blood Rebirth.’

This Divine Skill was thoroughly understood by Lin Yuan and had been replicated onto his body for a century.

Whoosh.

The verification of the bloodline passed.

Lin Yuan immediately noticed the gourd beginning to change.

“Crimson liquid.”

Tilting the gourd downward, he soon saw the crimson liquid pooling.

Lin Yuan began to absorb it without hesitation.

…

Time passed.

Years went by in the blink of an eye.

Compared to the centuries before, these few years almost flashed by.

Martial Temple Cave Dwelling.

Lin Yuan was seated cross-legged, his Inner World vast and boundless, now reaching twenty-six million square miles.

One should know, the upper limit for human civilization Evolvers was only ten million square miles due to racial constraints, almost impossible to break through.

Yet Lin Yuan’s Inner World easily reached twenty-six million square miles, a fact that, if known to the Main World Human Civilization Alliance, could likely provoke the intervention of a Supreme Being.

Such means to transcend racial limits, even for a Supreme Being, required a grievous price, yet could the liquid inside the gourd effortlessly achieve this?

Inner World.

Lin Yuan’s figure solidified.

“Such an immense Cosmic Force…”

Lin Yuan momentarily became engrossed, as in the Main World his Inner World merely spanned ten million square miles and was still within the suppression limits for human civilization Evolvers.

But now, his twenty-six million square-mile Inner World, brimming with overwhelming Cosmic Force, made even Lin Yuan’s heart throb.

The difference between ten million square miles and twenty million square miles was certainly more than twice.

“Eighth Layer invincible, my current strength, even without employing the ‘Strengthening’ Divine Skill, should have reached the level of Eighth Layer invincible,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Theoretically, an Inner World spanning tens of millions of square miles could match the potential of an Eighth Layer invincible.

But that would be under the condition of having just an Inner World of that magnitude; solely the overwhelming Cosmic Force could contest the Cosmic Force devised by an Eighth Layer invincible.

Lin Yuan’s current Inner World might be just over twenty million square miles, but he had many other methods at his disposal.

Combined combat power already matched that of a typical Eighth Layer invincible.

“Only…”

Lin Yuan slightly raised his head, looking up at the sky above.

A sphere formed entirely by the Power of Taiyin and the Power of Taiyang was hovering there.

Ever since Lin Yuan re-entered the Seventh Rank and began constructing his Inner World, the complete Taiyin Rule and Taiyang Rule manifested in the Inner World and started to merge.

That was what led to the current scene,

transforming into a sphere completely composed of Taiyin and Taiyang.

Lin Yuan could feel that within the sphere, as the Taiyin Rule and Taiyang Rule merged, they began transforming and transcending.

So he did not meddle too much.

“It should be close to completing its transformation.”

Lin Yuan carefully sensed for a while; each strand of the transformation inside the sphere naturally occurred, and though Lin Yuan could intervene, he knew it was best to observe and let it unfold.

“Could it really be about to give birth to a brand new rule—the Taiji Rule?”

Lin Yuan speculated in his heart.

The Dao of Taiji, an original creation by Lin Yuan, was unlike the elemental forces of metal, wood, water, fire, earth, light, or thunder already existing in the cosmic world.

The Dao of Taiji, the Taiji Rule, had never appeared before Lin Yuan’s creation, whether in the Main World or in other traversable worlds.

…

Xianyao City.

A luxurious estate.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared there.

“Chang Er, have you come?” Shen Zhen was watering flowers in the garden; upon seeing Lin Yuan, she immediately exclaimed in surprise.

Lin Jianping was cultivating when he heard Shen Zhen’s exclamation, immediately coming out of seclusion and stepping through the door, he too saw Lin Yuan.

“Chang Er, you haven’t been here in a long time,” Lin Jianping said with a smile, “What’s the matter? Too much going on at the Martial Temple?”

“It’s manageable,” Lin Yuan shook his head.

The affairs of the Martial Temple weren’t managed by him, and even several Supreme Elders wouldn’t interfere with those trivial matters at the Martial Temple.

But meditating occasionally for a few years was nothing unusual.

Lin Yuan generally visited his parents every time he finished a meditation retreat.

“Chang Er, you’re working too hard, whether it’s cultivating or doing other stuff, you need to focus on resting, who knows, you might achieve even better results,”
